_comment: Owner feedback on run 16 (2026-08-06), translated into checkable expectations.
Unlike ground_truth.json (full shelf labels), these are SPOT checks: only the
spines the owner explicitly flagged. 'forbid' = catalog ids that must not be
claimed by the shelf at any tier; 'want' = at least one of these ids should be
claimed (tier irrelevant); 'want_unmatched' = these spine reads must yield no
match (a wrong claim is worse than none); 'not_auto' = the id may be claimed
but not at AUTO tier (genuine ambiguity a human must resolve).
